fact: At a workshop on 9 August 2024 an ONIP legal expert said the Fichier général de la population is the single source for data used to produce secure titles and that civil status events (births, deaths, marriages) feed the FGP, with the civil status and FGP systems to be interoperable.
title: Enregistrement à l'état-civil : le renforcement de la communication recommandé à la RDC
